content_sections.heading: IVRI Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IVRI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IVRI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Assistant: Bachelor's degree in science, 3 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology. Experience of working in R&D laboratories preferred. Project Associate II: Master's degree in Natural/ life sciences or Agricultural sciences/ Veterinary Science /Animal Science. 2 years’ experience in R&D and NET/GATE qualification. Field/Administrative Assistant: Graduate degree in any discipline.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Project Assistant: Maximum Age: 50 years Project Associate II: Maximum Age: 35 years Field/Administrative Assistant: Maximum Age: 50 years

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IVRI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Veterinary Research Institute (IVRI), located in Izatnagar, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available under IVRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Project Assistant, Project Associate II, and Field/Administrative Assistant under various project-based research roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies distributed across the Project Assistant, Project Associate II, and Field/Administrative Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection mode for IVRI recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process is entirely based on a Walk-in-Interview where candidates can directly appear with their documents.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 01 October 2026 at the designated venue in Izatnagar.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Project Associate II?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's degree in Natural/life sciences, Agricultural sciences, Veterinary Science, or Animal Science with 2 years of R&D experience and NET/GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Project Associate II post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate II position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 35,000 per month plus 18% HRA depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring an application with a colored photograph, brief CV, one set of self-attested photocopies of all certificates, age proof, and original certificates for verification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for IVRI Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.
